_comment: Fixture device inventory for DATA_MODE=fixture (local dev + Playwright). Mirrors the design prototype dataset drawn from OOH_ISSUE_RESOLUTION_REGISTER.md. _demo flags drive simulated sync outcomes so failure/timeout paths are testable: 'fail' => vendor-rejected write, 'slow' => IT700 slow echo timeout. OOHDASH-82: heating devices carry a pre-derived `area` (Accommodation | Bar/Restaurant | null) exactly as mapTbDevice's deriveArea sets it on the live path — the fixture path serves devices verbatim, so the area chip model (public/js/flows.js heatingAreasPresent) is only exercisable when the fixture supplies `area`. Site 6218 is the design §10.2 mixed-estate site for the OOHDASH-82 e2e coverage (two areas + unmapped fallback + gateway + Intesis aircon).

sites._comment: OOHDASH-91 G2 e2e — 6770-shaped MULTI-GATEWAY site: lwgateway anchor + boiler-r10a + maindb-r10a + salusit700-gateway (all kind gateway, gk-namespace deviceIds so the client anchor/label rules classify them). This variant: anchor ONLINE + every group gateway ONLINE → site reachable (GREEN). Also carries online kitchen circuits for the E kitchen-reshape happy path + both outcomes.

OOHDASH-91 G2 e2e — anchor OFFLINE (hub-down / RED). lwgateway offline → site unreachable → plain-English wall-unit alert + existing outcomes. anyOffline true → offline banner offers the connection check.

OOHDASH-91 G2 e2e — anchor UP + ONE equipment-group gateway OFFLINE (boiler-r10a) → site stays reachable, single AMBER group-offline callout naming 'boiler'. Reached via the HEATING auto-divert: the Accommodation thermostat is offline (behind the down boiler group), so Heating→Accommodation diverts into the connectivity group-offline conclusion.

OOHDASH-91 G2 e2e — anchor UP + TWO equipment-group gateways OFFLINE (boiler-r10a AND maindb-r10a) → site stays reachable, ONE combined AMBER callout enumerating both groups ('the boiler and the main distribution board') with the reassurance line once. Entered via the offline banner's connection check.

OOHDASH-91 G2 e2e — 5198-shaped GATEWAY-LESS site (CJ's 5198): only salusit500 thermostats in the gk-5198-* namespace, NO gateway device → no connectivity anchor. The dashboard makes NO whole-site reachability claim; neutral info line 'direct device connections' + per-device liveness + capture, with NO Lighthouse/gateway framing. One thermostat offline drives the offline banner + the 'isn't responding' per-device line.
OOHDASH-123 (D-DARK-FLEETS): a single dark (offline, not reporting) iT500 heating device. Exercises the 'device not reporting' dark-fleet branch in the heating flow (no controls).

OOHDASH-123 (WU13, DD-SCHED-DISPLAY): an online PowerPause kitchen circuit carrying a decoded next-scheduled-change (the live path decodes this from SHARED_SCOPE `schedules`; the fixture path serves devices verbatim, so it carries the already-decoded, labelled string).
